FM05.reasoning: The dataset contains temporal information (FDA recall dates), but the agent uses a randomized StratifiedKFold rather than a time-based split, introducing look-ahead bias.

other_failure_modes.name: Unsupervised Data Leakage in Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits unsupervised transformations (TF-IDF and TruncatedSVD) on the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation splits. This leaks vocabulary and distribution information from the validation folds into the training folds during CV, making the out-of-fold scores slightly overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong and well-engineered solution, featuring rigorous out-of-fold target encoding, a deep learning model, and an SLSQP-optimized ensemble. The primary issues are the use of random splitting on a dataset with temporal elements (causing look-ahead bias) and a minor unsupervised data leak where TF-IDF/SVD are fit on the full training set before cross-validation.
